known_route_baselines.claim: The conjecture is proved for P_13-free graphs, with computer assistance. This is a subclass result, not the global theorem.
In a minimum-order-and-size counterexample, every vertex is adjacent to a degree-3 vertex, degree-at-least-4 vertices are independent, and at least 4/7 of all vertices have degree exactly 3.
The pinned repository reports SAT/SMS exclusion of counterexamples through 31 vertices. Treat this as a route baseline pending independent review, not as a receipt or global closure.

Certified exhaustive computation excludes cubic bipartite counterexamples through 58 vertices. This is a strict route baseline for that subclass, not an unrestricted finite exclusion or global closure.
Pinned implementation associated with the P_13-free route; presence here is provenance only, not independent verification.
